title: LTCF Data Validation Guidance | NHSN | CDC
content: LTCF Data Validation Guidance Print Minus Related Pages Internal Validation: Active efforts by a reporting facility to assure completeness and accuracy of NHSN data. External Validation: Survey and audit process by external agency to assure quality of NHSN surveillance and reporting.
